parameters.name: AccessRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region from which the PrivateZone service is accessed.

The access region is the region from which the PrivateZone service is accessed.

Call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is located.

parameters.name: HostVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC instance that is associated with the PrivateZone service.
